latest_action.text: Placed on Senate Legislative Calendar under General Orders. Calendar No. 629.

card.summary: The S. 91, Western Wildfire Support Act of 2026, directs federal agencies to improve wildfire preparation, detection, suppression support, and post-fire recovery. The bill mandates better transparency in firefighting accounts, updates strategic wildland fire management policies, expands detection equipment and technology, and establishes permanent Burned Area Emergency Response Teams and a long-term rehabilitation account.
